top_reasons.description: Detected a region covering approximately 11.9% of the image with a compression error level significantly higher than the rest of the document. This pattern is commonly seen when a photo or region has been pasted in from a different source and re-saved.

Found 1 line(s) (out of 8 checked) where words on the SAME line have inconsistent heights. Genuine printed lines keep a consistent font size within that line; this can indicate a word was pasted in from a different source. (Normal document-wide differences, like a large title vs smaller body text, are not flagged.)

Found 11 word(s) with unusually low OCR confidence relative to the rest of the document's text. This can indicate that region has different visual characteristics (e.g. from being edited/pasted) than genuinely printed text.
No camera make/model found in metadata. Genuine phone photos or scans usually retain this; its absence can indicate the image was edited, screenshotted, or re-saved (which strips this data).
